summary: Defines the IANA Charset MIB, with a textual convention called IANACharset for naming character sets in MIB objects. It is now an IANA registry and was extracted from Printer MIB v2 (RFC 3805). It is informational.

eli5.summary: This is a list of names of text alphabets and codes that device dashboards can use to say what text format they use.
